series_end_reason: From the Q1 2026 report the brand is no longer a separate line; it sits within a therapy-class line whose footnote names it (long-acting insulin 'Comprises Tresiba, Xultophy, Levemir and Awiqli'). Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 contain no row for the brand.
series_start_reason: Q1 2016 is the earliest quarter with a Ryzodeg-only figure: the Q1 2017 report prints it as the prose comparative ('reached DKK 95 million compared with DKK 34 million in 2016') and the Q2, 9M and FY 2017 reports print the 2016 year-to-date comparatives (72, 114, 196). Reports for 2013 through Q4 2016 print Ryzodeg only inside the combined 'new-generation insulin' line (footnote: 'comprises Tresiba, Ryzodeg and Xultophy'), apart from approval and launch text, so no earlier own-line figure exists. Q1 2017 is the first report with Ryzodeg as its own table line.
moa: Soluble co-formulation of ultra-long-acting basal insulin (insulin degludec 70%) and rapid-acting insulin (insulin aspart 30%)
notes: Worldwide net sales in DKK million as printed; FDA approval is NDA 203313 on 2015-09-25 (Drugs@FDA); the Japanese approval of December 2012 and the European Commission authorisation of January 2013 predate it and are not the first_approval_year basis. Quarters 2016Q2, 2016Q3, 2016Q4, 2017Q2, 2017Q3, 2017Q4, 2018Q2 and 2018Q3 are year-to-date less the preceding year-to-date; the Q4 2018 report prints the first quarter-only regional row and later quarters are read directly. The 2016 quarters come from prior-year comparatives in the 2017 reports (Q1 2016 34 direct; H1 2016 72, 9M 2016 114 and FY 2016 196 differenced), and sum to the stated FY 2016 of 196.
